speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my clinic. I'm here to help you manage your acute diarrhea, but first I need to understand the severity and timing of your symptoms. How many times have you had a bowel movement in the last 24 hours, and has there been any blood or mucus in the stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Levofloxacin-induced Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI). REQUEST TEST: C. diff toxin assay. REQUEST IMAGES: None required at this time.
